description: Deep Learning Solar Panels 2023 (LGATE 481 (series on Western Australian Government Data Catalogue) is a series of datasets listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. 2D solar panel outlines derived from Perth metropolitan imagery January/February 2023 (north, central and south metro areas) using a deep learning algorithm. The algorithm was created within Landgate to demonstrate to approved State and Local Government (Government) entities the capabilities of Deep Learning [DL] and Artificial Intelligence [AI] algorithms. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are AI, CaptureWA, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Solar. It offers 10 resource(s) in .pdf, api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Government Use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
